text:
Anna (PM): Quick: Im putting together a short 'Network Custody Readiness' one-pager for private deploys where customers manage networking. Need concise guarantees + customer signoff gate.

Raj (Eng): From engs POV minimal guarantees: rolling, non-destructive agent upgrades; documented rollback that restores agent + egress mapping; signed airgap artifacts; preflight that errors with remediation hints.

Marta (Field): Field requires a clear customer responsibilities column: named network owner, ASN/IP confirmation, firewall windows, DNS cutover slot, and who calls the BGP change. We should include an example acceptance line customers sign.

Kyle (NetOps): NetOps gating: mandatory BGP handoff dry-run that validates egress IP continuity and AS path. Installer must output egress->node mapping (machine-readable) and we run verifier. Commands we use: show bgp summary, traceroute from probes, and curl to egress IP with --interface. Dry-run signoff required before cutover.

Jia (SRE): Observability min: upgrade_progress, agent_versions, node_egress_ips, upgrade_errors. Need an event timeline that maps operator actions to system events. Telemetry toggles must respect customer KMS and allow sanitization. Also a 1-page troubleshooting playbook for top failures.

Ben (Solutions): Add a scheduling template: recommended 2-3 hour maintenance window, DNS TTL guidance (60s preferred), and a customer comms snippet. Also add a rollback-owner contact in the schedule.

Anna (PM): Proposed one-pager bullets (short):
- Preflight: network reachability, required ports, kernel/disk checks, NAT/iptables scan, egress mapping verified
- Dry-run: BGP handoff simulation + egress continuity check (NetOps sign-off)
- Upgrade: canary (5-10%) -> full; rolling agents, non-destructive
- Rollback: documented, timeboxed <45m target for supported configs; rollback script + checklist
- Packaging: online installer + sha256-signed airgap bundle
- Observability: minimal metrics + event log; telemetry opt-out; KMS-aware
- Support: contracted cutover assistance + P1 triage SLA during window
- Customer must: assign network owner, provide ASN/IPs, approve dry-run, open firewall windows, schedule DNS cutover
- Exclusions: misconfigured customer BGP, failed hardware, unsupported kernel mods

Marta (Field): Add an "expectations" line for DNS: "If customer TTLs >300s expect propagation delays; plan accordingly." Also include signoff line: "Network owner: name / email / signature / date."

Kyle (NetOps): Ill supply the dry-run checklist and a small verifier script. Will include exact commands and the egress mapping JSON schema. ETA Tue EOD.

Raj (Eng): Ill own preflight tooling + rollback runbook and add machine-readable exit codes. ETA Tue EOD.

Jia (SRE): Ill provide metrics spec + 1-page runbook and telemetry sanitization steps. ETA Wed AM.

Anna (PM): GA gating: propose require two successful customer-verified cutovers on distinct topologies (one on-prem BGP, one cloud VPC) with rollback exercised and NetOps + Eng signoff for each. Agree?

Marta (Field): Strong yes. Two topologies and live rollback tests prevented past surprises. Require post-cutover report signed by field + network owner.

Raj (Eng): Agreed. Define success: canary->full upgrade, rollback executed if exercised, no IP drift for 48h, metrics stable, signed post-cutover report.

Kyle (NetOps): Also require at least one cutover to be done under airgap or constrained-control-plane conditions. NetOps sign-off mandatory.

Anna (PM): Owners recap: Raj=preflight & rollback; Kyle=dry-run & verifier; Jia=metrics & runbook; Ben=customer one-pager layout; Marta=customer responsibilities & signoff language. Ill assemble the one-pager and ping for signoff Thu AM. Thanks. :pray:

deploy-bot: New doc uploaded: /docs/private-deploy/network-custody-readiness.md (internal)

Marta (Field): Noted  will review the draft when posted. :eyes:
